name: Guardsman Training
summary: Gain proficiency in two skills from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Perception, Stealth, and Survival. You also gain proficiency with one specialist weapon group: sniper weapons, plasma weapons, melta weapons, or heavy weapons.
